title: Roman numerals to integer
requirement: Implement `roman_to_int(s: str) -> int` that converts a Roman numeral (symbols I, V, X, L, C, D, M; subtractive notation such as IV=4, IX=9, XL=40, XC=90, CD=400, CM=900) to an integer. Accept uppercase only. Raise ValueError for an empty string or any character that is not one of the seven uppercase symbols.
